name: Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, Etc.
description: Korea's foundational network-utilization and cybersecurity-incident-reporting statute, enacted 1986 (Act No. 3848), heavily amended since (most recent amendments effective August 14, 2024 strengthening breach-reporting obligations). Predates and complements PIPA (secid:regulation/pipc.go.kr/pipa) — most personal-information provisions moved to PIPA in the 2020 'Data 3 Laws' reform; this Act still covers ISP obligations, spam/malware provisions, and network breach notification.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Ministry of Science and ICT (msit.go.kr) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Ministry of Science and ICT (msit.go.kr).
